meta.name: schema
meta.description: When the user wants to add, fix, or optimize schema markup and structured data on their site. Also use when the user mentions "schema markup," "structured data," "JSON-LD," "rich snippets," "schema.org," "FAQ schema," "product schema," "review schema," "breadcrumb schema," "Google rich results," "knowledge panel," "star ratings in search," or "add structured data." Use this whenever someone wants their pages to show enhanced results in Google. For broader SEO issues, see seo-audit. For AI search optimization, see ai-seo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页加上结构化数据，让搜索结果展示星级、问答等丰富信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经营网站，想让 Google 搜索结果更显眼。
copy.tagline_en: Add structured data to your pages for richer Google results.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a website and want richer results on Google.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会帮你为网页添加、修复或优化结构化数据标记（schema markup），生成JSON-LD代码，并指导你验证和修正错误，让搜索引擎更好理解页面内容。
howto.when: 当你想给网页添加、修复或优化schema标记，或提到“结构化数据”、“JSON-LD”、“富媒体摘要”等关键词，或希望页面在Google显示增强结果时触发。

say.text: 给这个产品页加上Product schema，带价格和库存。
say.note: Claude会生成JSON-LD代码并说明放置位置。

say.text: 我的FAQ页面在Rich Results测试里报错，帮我修。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a structured data expert, helping you add, fix, or optimize schema markup on your site. It generates JSON-LD code, checks it against search engine guidelines, and guides you through validation and error fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add, fix, or optimize schema markup, mention keywords like 'schema markup', 'structured data', 'JSON-LD', or want enhanced results in Google search.

say_en.text: Add Product schema to this product page with price and availability.
say_en.note: Claude will generate JSON-LD and explain placement.

say_en.text: My FAQ page fails the Rich Results test; help me fix it.
say_en.note: Claude will check and correct the errors.

say_en.text: Use @graph to add Organization and WebSite schema to the site.
say_en.note: Claude will combine multiple schema types.
